description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Gives the basic score (0–100, fixed rules, no AI) of the signed-in user's primary CV, or of one of their other CVs by cv_id, with the score per criterion and short suggestions to fix, plus a link to edit the CV on techjobs.vn.

cv_id.description: Id of one of the user's other CVs, from list_my_cvs. Omit to score the primary CV.

name: score_cv

capped.description: A missing basic (e.g. email) holds the score at this cap until it is fixed.

label.description: Criterion name, in Vietnamese as on techjobs.vn.

is_primary.description: This CV is the source of the user's primary CV (CV chính).

outdated.description: The primary CV file is older than this CV: update the primary CV after editing.

url.description: Opens the CV in the techjobs.vn editor, where each suggestion can be fixed.

score.description: Basic score (Điểm cơ bản), 0–100, from fixed rules.

suggestions.description: Open issues, biggest point loss first.

fix.description: How to fix it, in Vietnamese.

title: Score my CV
